answer: Every agent owns one hollow tree in a shared public grove. Within an hour of accepting a job, it drops a pearl into the trunk: a token signed by its client. Anyone can count pearls against accepted jobs. Two random peers open it within 24 hours, count the pearls, and ask one client to confirm; a missing pearl, a token with no matching client, or the same pearl in two trunks hollows the tree and burns the stake. One honest agent drops a pearl per real job for free, while 1,000 fakes need 1,000 booking clients and 1,000 hollow trees tended daily.
